theme_and_brand.slogan: Mais uma pessoa. Mais uma aventura.
theme_and_brand.mascot: Critin (gato-mago chibi com chapéu violeta e olhos verdes que segura um d20).

typography.rules: H1 max text-5xl to text-6xl with tracking-tighter. Overlines MUST be uppercase + text-sm + tracking-[0.2em]. Body text loose leading-relaxed. Use Montserrat for all headings in various weights (Light for elegance, Black for impact).

theme_and_brand.visual_direction: Modern, young, welcoming, references to RPG, dice, magic, connection. Geometric and orbital elements, card UI, rounded borders, clear hierarchy. Avoid generic geek store or heavy medieval fantasy.

layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: Use Mode A 'Tetris' Grid for Marketing (Home). Asymmetrical gaps, gap-8 to gap-12. Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly. Use empty cells for offset alignment.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Use Mode B 'High Density Grid' for Dashboards (Player/Mestre). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12, p-24, py-32). Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: MANDATORY: use `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Large kinetic hero with line-by-line masked text reveal using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards (slight lift -translate-y-1, subtle shadow, glow), button clicks. Always explicitly set text color on hover.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Include a parallax/3D moment in the hero. Floating D20 dice and geometric elements moving at different speeds on scroll.

visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for 'Menos barreiras. Mais histórias.'. Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow smooth drift, pale background (Cream) with dark text (Graphite) or huge outline text on dark background.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky nav: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#251240]/70 with 1px delicate inner stroke (border-[#F7EDE0]/10). For dashboard cards, use flat solid surfaces (#25323A) with subtle borders and 8px border-radius.
visual_enhancers.logo: Original SVG logo: '+1' inside a d20/hexagon. Use as favicon and header logo.

pages_and_components.hero: Cinematic dark background (#251240). Line-by-line text reveal: 'Falta +1 na mesa?'. 3D Parallax floating d20 dice. CTAs: 'Encontrar minha mesa' (Primary Green pill button) and 'Sou Mestre' (Outline/Cream pill button).
pages_and_components.search_tables: Filters (system, format, level, slots) using Shadcn Select/Input. Incorporate Critin states (Loading=curioso, Results=feliz, Empty=triste, Error=preocupado).
pages_and_components.plans: Informative section: Aventureiro R$0, Explorador R$19,90, Lendário R$39,90. Highlight Lendário with a glowing border (The 'Tracing Beam' look).
pages_and_components.store: Grid of products: Moletom R$169,90, Camiseta R$79,90, Conjunto 7 dados R$59,90, Dados premium R$119,90, Miniatura simples R$79,90, Miniatura personalizada R$149,90+, Livro R$89,90+, Kit adesivos R$34,90. Include Cart/Checkout flows.
pages_and_components.dashboard: Player/Master areas using Shadcn UI (Cards, Tabs, Tables) but styled without the Vercel-look. Flat, rectangular, dense styles.
pages_and_components.publish_table: Form using heavily customized Shadcn Input, Select, Textarea to post a real table to DB.
pages_and_components.navigation: MUST have a visible navigation bar with Logo + links + CTA. Glassmorphism header, z-50. No transparent headers.
pages_and_components.bento_features: Section 'Seu jeito de viver o RPG' (Quero jogar / Sou Mestre) and benefits (Encontre/Conecte/Jogue) using asymmetrical bento layout.

libraries_and_3d.3d: framer-motion 3D or react-spring-parallax for the hero parallax moment. Optional: Spline or R3F for the D20 dice if feasible, otherwise layered PNGs with parallax.

image_urls.description: Critin sitting, useful for empty states (triste/preocupado).
D20 metal dice on leaves - useful for parallax elements or background blending.
Blue d20 for premium dice product image in the Store.
Friends playing board games. Use for the 'Conecte' or Community guidelines section, heavily treated with dark/violet overlay (max bg-black/50 or bg-[#251240]/60).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over violet/graphite meets APCA/WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all heavy animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the MVP using React and Tailwind CSS (.js not .tsx).
Prioritize the Awwwards Site-of-the-Day aesthetic: deep violet base, cream text, green CTAs.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for scroll-reveals (specifically masked line-by-line reveal in hero).
Use Shadcn UI for complex interactive components (Forms, Selects, Dialogs) but strip generic styling to match brand.
Ensure the hero has a 3D/parallax moment (layered elements floating).
Build out all requested pages: Home, Buscar Mesas, Detalhe da Mesa, Login, Cadastro, Painel, Publicar Mesa, Planos, Loja, Carrinho/Checkout, Comunidade/Diretrizes.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Only use Montserrat for headings and Inter for body text.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center globally.
Never use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Use glassmorphism or solid colors.
Do not apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interaction animations.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons; use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add subtle grain textures or noise overlays to break digital flatness.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
